name: MOTS-c
aliases: Mitochondrial Open Reading Frame of 12S rRNA-c
effects: Mitochondria-encoded peptide — regulates metabolism by translocating to nucleus under stress
Improves insulin sensitivity; activates AMPK and the folate cycle (AICAR pathway)
Extends lifespan in rodent models; exercise-mimetic metabolic effects
Anti-obesity: reduces fat mass and improves metabolic flexibility in mice
Levels decline with age — positioned as longevity intervention target
No human clinical trial data; dosing protocols entirely based on animal studies
Extremely limited human safety data; no established adverse effect profile
Sourced from research-chemical suppliers — purity and sterility not guaranteed; risk of contamination
